description: READ-ONLY pre-flight for a generate_scene intent table: returns the scene capability report (es-plus.capabilities@1 — which keys are accepted / degraded / unsupported / missing) plus deterministic per-field issues (unknown surfaces, duplicate props, missing formtype, membership flags such as inQuery, labels absent from the spec, system fields inside an editable form, malformed dialog entries). It judges and never repairs or generates. Call it after extracting surfaces from a PRD / wireframe and before generating; fix the errors and re-run.

intent.description: The scene intent table (scene='crud': name/apiUrl/surfaces…; fragments: fields…). The same object you would pass as generate_scene's `intent`.

scene.description: The scene the intent is for — same value you would pass to generate_scene.

spec.description: Optional spec text (PRD / wireframe transcription). When present, every field label must appear verbatim in it — the check catches labels the host paraphrased instead of copying.

name: validate_intent
